futureRecordPolicy: M1 supplies canonical shapes where present in audited v2; typed owners are declared before records are authored in their owning milestone. No synthesized IDs or fake operations/solutions. A known reference without a registered typed record fails closure.
mechanicalAuthority: UNRESOLVED and PROBABLE cannot certify authoritative mechanical dependencies. Process maturity never upgrades confidence.
phasePolicy: Predicate version 1 and operand/target/unit/comparator/phase table in SEMANTIC_CONTRACT section 5 are mandatory.
invalidation: Relevant record, reference, schema, evidence, validator or hash-policy changes invalidate G-DATA; retain superseded records and recompute transitive impact.
